subject.title: Session hangs indefinitely when compaction times out, causing repeated duplicate message sends

question: Should this issue remain the canonical combined tracker for compaction-timeout session wedging plus duplicate Telegram-visible sends, or should maintainers split it into the narrower compaction-progress and duplicate-delivery trackers?
rationale: Current main has partial mitigations and open related work, but no merged source or live proof shows one repair covers both the stuck-session and duplicate-send symptoms.

options.title: Keep Combined Canonical
options.body: Use this issue as the canonical combined tracker and require fixes to prove both compaction timeout recovery and outbound duplicate suppression.

options.title: Split By Subproblem
options.body: Make https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/92043 and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/96242 canonical for their slices, preserving this issue as context until both are resolved.

options.title: Adopt Current PR First
options.body: Review and land or reject https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/92899, then decide whether duplicate-delivery work remains under this issue.

recommendation.title: Keep Combined Canonical
recommendation.body: Use this issue as the canonical combined tracker and require fixes to prove both compaction timeout recovery and outbound duplicate suppression.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the current assignee and adjacent area contributor, and this is primarily a tracker-boundary/product repair-shape decision.
